final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.district_id, s.region, s.client_count, CAST(s.client_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL) SELECT region, AVG(client_count), AVG(share) FROM step3 GROUP BY region
